definition_local_attach_ck.name: definition_local_attach_ck
definition_local_attach_ck.value:
("definition"."scope" = 'local') = ("definition"."attach_kind" is not null)
				and ("definition"."attach_kind" is null or (
					("definition"."attach_kind" = 'rcos_artifact') = ("definition"."attach_rcos_artifact_key" is not null)
					and ("definition"."attach_kind" = 'community_artifact') = ("definition"."attach_community_artifact_id" is not null)
				))

evidence_settled_ck.name: evidence_settled_ck
evidence_settled_ck.value:
("evidence"."state" = 'suggested' and "evidence"."confirmed_by" is null and "evidence"."confirmed_at" is null)
				or ("evidence"."state" in ('confirmed', 'dismissed') and "evidence"."confirmed_by" is not null and "evidence"."confirmed_at" is not null)
				or ("evidence"."state" = 'stale')
